name: 리 다이린
visual_review: 도트 얼굴과 원본 의상/술병이 읽히며 돌진·장타·팔꿈치·차기·마무리의 몸 동작이 구분됩니다. 4×3 셀에 각 동작이 포함됩니다.
motion_summary: Drunken martial artist Li Dailin. R rushes forward into a four-hit suppression combo. Animate loose tipsy guard, dip hips, short forward burst, palm strike, elbow, low twisting kick, rising knee, final heavy palm, backwards settle to tipsy guard. Amber/orange speed swishes and compact pale-gold impacts. Keep flask costume and warm relaxed eyes from identity, not glaring Nia eyes.
